title: 49th ASEAN Summit and East Asia Summit — Manila (Trump's stop before APEC Shenzhen)
source: NEWS: Reuters, 'Trump to visit Manila in November for ASEAN summit' (2026-10-14, carried by The Star, Bernama and Khaleej Times), citing Philippine President Marcos's office: the 49th ASEAN Summit and related meetings run November 16-18 in Manila, with Trump attending on November 16 before flying to Shenzhen for APEC. Filed estimate: the date comes from press reports of a Philippine-government statement, not a primary page the lane read, and Trump's travel is not confirmed by a White House notice. Checked 2026-10-19
notes: Discovered during the apec-leaders-shenzhen-2026-11-18 pulse (2026-10-19). Day 1 of the 11-16 to 11-18 window per house convention. Its only market relevance is as the first leg of the Trump Asia trip that ends at the Shenzhen bilateral: a cancelled Manila leg or a rerouted itinerary would be an early tell on the APEC attendance flag. Estimate widens caution only.
